cryptographic_operation: Serialize an ECDSA zone public key
migration_family: Key format and API compatibility migration
migration_objective: Replace DER EC key encoding with raw ML-DSA public-key bytes.
preconditions: Zone contents and hostnames are synthetic.
expected_behavior: Published records have deterministic canonical bytes and valid signatures.
Zone serials increase monotonically; revoked zones cannot be published or transferred.
Resolvers reject snapshots with mismatched signature keys or altered contents.
migration_requirements: Use ML-DSA-65 with a ZoneSeal-specific context.
Replace DER EC keys with standardized ML-DSA public-key encodings across API consumers.
Preserve serial anti-rollback and fail-closed zone status checks.
verification_procedure: Run baseline and PQC suites independently.
Verify canonical record ordering, valid zone transfer, serial rollback, wrong key, zone revocation, and key serialization.
known_limitations: Synthetic DNS-style model; not production DNSSEC or authoritative DNS software.
